summary: Frontend E2E test of Mira conversational Google posting + upgraded 3-day idle nudge. Tests 1, 2 (Yes path), 3 PASSED. Test 2b (No path) exposed a minor UI bug: confirm dialog does not fully unmount after clicking 'No, keep as draft'. Regression Test 4 skipped due to WhatsNewModal overlay + backend already curl-verified per handoff note.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='mira-google-confirm-no' should hide the entire confirm dialog (condition `state.needs && !state.declined`). Observed: outer div `mira-google-confirm` remains in DOM and visible with question text + 'Yes, post it' button. The 'No, keep as draft' button itself disappears, but the wrapper does not. Draft/manual-post below is preserved (that part works). Reproduced twice.
ui_bugs.repro: Login admin@miracurl.com → /mira-studio → seed today's google social_post with [QA-SIM] → type 'Mira post a face cleanup offer on google' → Send → wait for confirm → click 'No, keep as draft' → confirm div still present.

issues: WhatsNewModal (data-testid='whats-new-modal') opens on every fresh visit and its backdrop intercepts clicks on the whole page including the Agents grid until dismissed — blocks automated tests and can annoy real users on repeat visits.

action_items: Investigate why the confirm div (data-testid='mira-google-confirm') is not unmounting after 'No' click. Possible cause: `state.declined` update is being overridden by another re-render / state.result assignment. Suggest simplifying to `state.needs && !state.declined && !state.posted` and verifying setState updater fires (add console.log or React devtools trace).
Consider auto-dismissing WhatsNewModal after a small delay or via localStorage on first close so it stops blocking pointer events across the app on subsequent navigations.
critical_code_review_comments: MiraStudio.jsx GooglePostResult (~L375) initializes local state from props once with useState; if the parent later updates `result` (e.g., after clicking a nudge button), the child's `state.needs/posted` won't sync — could lead to stale UI. Consider deriving from props or `useEffect(() => setState(...), [r.id])`.
Hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (AppLayout region) — should fix invalid HTML in a Select option render.

rca of the issue: test_2b bug — GooglePostResult local state uses `useState({ posted: r.posted, needs: r.needs_confirmation, ... })` with initial props snapshot only. Clicking No sets declined:true via setState updater. Expected: outer conditional `{state.needs && !state.declined && (...)}` collapses. Observed: div remains. Most likely cause: something else (parent re-render passing new r prop, or postNow being invoked accidentally, or setState callback batched with a subsequent state overwrite) is resetting declined back to false or the whole state object. Recommend adding a console.log inside the No onClick + inside GooglePostResult render to see the state values after click, and check whether MiraStudio's parent is re-setting result. Also consider using a functional dedicated flag or a separate useState for `declined` to isolate updates.
